_about: Public-domain James Henley Thornwell (1812-1862, Southern Presbyterian theologian, South Carolina College and Columbia Seminary) for the Word Hoard: the Collected Writings (Richmond, 1871-73, ed. John B. Adger and John L. Girardeau, 4 vols) and two books he published himself, raw Internet Archive OCR from Princeton and California scans. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of it. Thornwell was a leading clerical defender of slavery and secession; his pamphlets on those subjects are listed under _excluded, not shelved, and the whole shelf awaits Adam's veto. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 5 (my pick). No uids minted.
